identity_resolution.name: Yaqi Xie
identity_resolution.note: Matched by official homepage, CMU/NUS publication history, coauthors, and primary-paper affiliation blocks. This is not a name-only search.

candidates.title: Unifying Deep Predicate Invention with Pre-trained Foundation Models

embodied_relevance.evidence: Learns symbolic predicates from robot demonstrations for long-horizon manipulation; evaluated in five simulated and one real-robot domain.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Bilevel framework joins LLM-proposed predicate effects with grounded neural predicate learning and learned feedback, bridging top-down and bottom-up predicate invention.

claim_support.evidence: Five simulated domains, a real Table Clean domain, strong baselines, representation comparisons and predicate-selection ablations support the claims.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, experiments, ablations and limitations were read from full text.

candidates.selection_reason: UniPred把基础模型的高层先验与示范数据中的低层视觉证据放入同一双层学习闭环；五个仿真域和一个真机域显示其成功率较纯自上而下方法高约2–4倍、学习速度较纯自下而上方法快约3–4倍。它补足看板中神经符号世界模型与长时序规划的空白。
risks_or_uncertainties: 假设低层控制器集合固定且环境完全可观测、确定性
谓词仍受人工先验和控制器—算子映射约束

candidates.title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation

asset_checks.note: Project page says Code Coming Soon; not counted.
Project page says Data Coming Soon; not counted.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Directly addresses continuous vision-language robot navigation and includes physical wheeled-robot deployment.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text and official project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Uses visible navigable pixels as a unified VLM-to-motion interface rather than low-level action tokens, plus visibility-aware keyframe memory.

claim_support.evidence: R2R-CE and RxR-CE results, call-efficiency comparisons, coordinate-loss ablations and real-robot demonstrations support the main claims.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, quantitative experiments, ablations and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: Goal2Pixel用图像中的可导航像素替代低层动作作为VLM与机器人运动的接口；在R2R-CE Val-Unseen达到54.1% SR、52.5% SPL，每回合仅7.75次VLM调用，相比直接动作预测的46.62次约少6倍。其主要增量是更清晰、低频的空间控制接口。
risks_or_uncertainties: 依赖深度信息
验证集中在室内VLN-CE，真机结果规模较小
代码与数据仍未发布

candidates.title: pySpatial: Generating 3D Visual Programs for Zero-Shot Spatial Reasoning

embodied_relevance.evidence: Builds explicit 3D spatial programs and deploys navigation plans on a Unitree Go1 quadruped.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv/OpenReview full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Composes reconstruction, pose recovery and novel-view tools through generated Python rather than relying on implicit MLLM spatial imagination.

claim_support.evidence: MindCube and Omni3D-Bench comparisons plus a physical navigation case support spatial-reasoning claims.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, benchmarks, real-world deployment and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: pySpatial把多视角输入变成可探索的3D场景，并让MLLM生成可执行、可检查的视觉程序；MindCube上比GPT-4.1-mini高12.94%。其真实Unitree Go1实验说明方法能进入机器人导航，但当前真机证据仍主要是一个50平方米实验室中的定性任务。
risks_or_uncertainties: 核心量化证据仍是空间问答基准而非机器人任务
真机高层位置命令被人工转换为速度目标，闭环自动化有限

candidates.title: ShapeGrasp: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Grasping with Large Language Models through Geometric Decomposition

embodied_relevance.evidence: Direct real-world task-oriented grasping on a Kinova Jaco arm.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Geometrically decomposes unseen objects into a structured graph, then uses LLM semantic-part and task-utility reasoning for zero-shot grasp selection.

claim_support.evidence: Real-robot object/task evaluations, GPT-4V and GraspGPT comparisons and reasoning ablations support the contribution.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, experiments, ablations and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: ShapeGrasp把凸几何分解、结构图和LLM常识推理组合为零样本任务导向抓取管线；真机上正确选中目标部件92%，抓取成功率82%，明显高于GPT-4V与GraspGPT对照。它是Yaqi Xie作品中最直接、证据较完整的机器人操作工作之一。
risks_or_uncertainties: 依赖合理的凸分解和已知物体名称
只执行自上而下抓取，复杂姿态与遮挡覆盖有限
推理时间约30秒

candidates.title: Let Me Help You! Neuro-Symbolic Short-Context Action Anticipation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Predicts a human partner's future actions to trigger assistive robot skills in joint salad preparation.

primary_source.evidence: Full author-hosted paper PDF and IEEE DOI metadata were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Injects object-affordance concept-graph knowledge into short-context action anticipation and maps predictions to assistive actions.

claim_support.evidence: 50Salads, Breakfast and a real joint cooking scenario show up to nine-point improvement and shorter observation requirements.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, benchmark experiments, robot scenario and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: NeSCA将场景物体的affordance知识注入短上下文动作预测，帮助协作机器人更早推断人的意图；在50Salads和Breakfast上最高提升约9个百分点，并在联合做沙拉场景中触发辅助动作。贡献明确，但真实HRI实验规模小于其视频预测证据。
risks_or_uncertainties: 真机协作证据规模较小
方法依赖预定义概念图和技能库

candidates.title: Embedding Symbolic Temporal Knowledge into Deep Sequential Models

embodied_relevance.evidence: Evaluates symbolic temporal embeddings in sequential action recognition and robot imitation learning.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full PDF was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Learns semantic embeddings of LTL-derived automata with a GNN and uses them to guide deep sequential models.

claim_support.evidence: Synthetic and robot-related downstream tasks, data-regime comparisons and ablations support the approach.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, experiments, analysis and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 该工作用GNN学习由LTL公式生成的自动机嵌入，再以此引导深度序列模型；在动作识别和机器人模仿学习等低数据任务上提供改进。它对理解Yaqi Xie后续神经符号机器人路线很重要，但资产缺失、实验规模与当前方法相比有限。
risks_or_uncertainties: 未找到可核验代码仓库
较旧工作且实验规模有限
符号知识需要人工提供

candidates.title: Multi-Task Trust Transfer for Human-Robot Interaction

embodied_relevance.evidence: Human-subject studies include a Fetch robot performing household tasks and model trust transfer for HRI decisions.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full PDF was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Introduces task-dependent latent trust representations and Bayesian, neural and hybrid transfer models for unseen tasks and users.

claim_support.evidence: Two task domains, human-subject data and unseen-task/user comparisons support trust-transfer claims.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Study design, models, results and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 这项工作通过Fetch家务任务与VR自动驾驶两类人因实验研究信任如何跨任务迁移，并比较贝叶斯、神经网络及混合模型在未见用户和任务上的预测。它是看板HRI信任板块的高信息增益补充，但不应与机器人学习算法按同一能力边界理解。
risks_or_uncertainties: 一部分证据来自VR自动驾驶而非实体机器人
年代较早，模型本身的技术影响已弱于其HRI结论

candidates.title: Robot Capability and Intention in Trust-based Decisions across Tasks

embodied_relevance.evidence: Studies how people delegate tasks to a simulated UAV based on perceived robot capability, intention and trust.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full PDF was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Separates capability and intention from scalar trust and tests their independent roles in delegation decisions across tasks.

claim_support.evidence: A 400-participant human-subject study supports the psychological conclusions.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Study design, analysis, results and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 400人在线研究显示，用户会综合机器人能力、意图与总体信任来决定是否委派任务，单一信任分数不足。结论对HRI很有价值，但实验主体是模拟UAV问卷，没有实体机器人闭环，因此只进入观察池。
risks_or_uncertainties: 没有实体机器人交互
在线情境材料与真实长期协作之间存在生态效度差距
未找到代码或数据资产

candidates.title: Translating Natural Language to Planning Goals with Large-Language Models

embodied_relevance.evidence: Translates human instructions into structured planning goals and evaluates on ALFRED household tasks as well as Blocksworld.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full PDF, project post and repository were checked.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Frames LLMs as natural-language-to-PDDL translators rather than unreliable end-to-end planners and systematically diagnoses failure modes.

claim_support.evidence: Controlled experiments on Blocksworld and ALFRED support both positive translation results and negative numerical/spatial findings.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, experiments, error analysis and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 该工作较早提出让LLM负责自然语言到PDDL目标的翻译、而非直接规划，并在Blocksworld与ALFRED中揭示其对欠明确指令的优势及数值、物理和空间推理失败。机器人闭环较弱，但这一正负结论至今仍有参考价值。
risks_or_uncertainties: 实验使用早期GPT-3.5模型，绝对性能已过时
ALFRED验证不等于实体机器人执行
对prompt较敏感

candidates.title: InstructPart: Affordance-based Part Segmentation from Language Instruction

asset_checks.note: Paper introduces a dataset, but no currently verified direct download was found in the checked primary pages.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Benchmarks instruction-conditioned object-part affordance grounding, a direct perception prerequisite for precise manipulation.

primary_source.evidence: OpenReview forum and full PDF were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Introduces task-instruction-conditioned part masks and evaluates VLM part-level grounding rather than object-level recognition.

claim_support.evidence: Dataset statistics and multi-model benchmark comparisons support the diagnostic claims.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Dataset design, experiments and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: InstructPart聚焦“按照家务指令定位应该交互的物体部件”，用54类物体、48类部件、32种affordance和38种动作构建细粒度分割基准。方向与机器人感知直接相关，但论文没有机器人执行，且当前未核验到数据下载入口，因此先观察。
risks_or_uncertainties: 没有机器人执行或闭环任务指标
当前未核验到数据直链
Workshop版本的实验证据较轻

candidates.title: Toward General-Purpose Robots via Foundation Models: A Survey and Meta-Analysis

embodied_relevance.evidence: Entire survey concerns foundation models for general-purpose robotics.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text and living repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Provides a robotics foundation-model taxonomy and meta-analysis.

claim_support.evidence: Current 100-point rubric requires author experiments/system results; this survey needs the future survey-specific rubric rather than an improvised score.

candidates.selection_reason: 这是高度相关且维护良好的机器人基础模型综述，但现行量表以原创方法的实验支持为硬门槛。为与既往批次一致，本轮不强行给分，待综述专用量表建立后再审。
risks_or_uncertainties: 现行量表不适合综述
2023年正文的时效性需要结合持续更新仓库重新评估

candidates.title: HiKER-SGG: Hierarchical Knowledge Enhanced Robust Scene Graph Generation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Core method and validation are robust scene-graph generation on corrupted visual benchmarks; robotics appears as a possible downstream use, not demonstrated evidence.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Hierarchical knowledge reasoning is a clear SGG contribution.

claim_support.evidence: Vision benchmark experiments support SGG claims.

candidates.selection_reason: 作者命中但没有机器人或物理任务实验，按硬门槛排除，不能因为论文提到机器人潜在用途而纳入。

candidates.title: Adaptively Coordinating with Novel Partners via Learned Latent Strategies

embodied_relevance.evidence: Coordination is evaluated in Overcooked and an online user study, without physical environment or robot evidence required by the board discovery spec.

primary_source.evidence: Official NeurIPS paper page is available.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Learned latent partner strategies are a clear multiagent contribution.

claim_support.evidence: Software-agent and user-study experiments support the stated coordination claims.

candidates.selection_reason: 这是高质量的人机协作/多智能体工作，但现有证据仍是Overcooked软件环境和在线用户研究；按看板规则，缺少物理环境或机器人验证时不以具身论文收录。

candidates.title: Non-embodied author matches (contextual safety, thought communication, self-correcting decoding, symbolic knowledge embedding)

embodied_relevance.evidence: These works address general MLLM safety, multiagent communication, LVLM hallucination, or generic symbolic neural learning without demonstrated robot/physical-task evidence.

primary_source.evidence: Official author page and linked primary pages identify the works.

incremental_contribution.evidence: They may have clear contributions in their own fields.

claim_support.evidence: Not evaluated further after relevance gate failure.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: No recommendation attempted after direct relevance gate failure.

candidates.selection_reason: 统一记录作者主页上的非具身命中，避免后续重复把作者声誉或关键词相关性误当作机器人证据。
